labels-absent.pdf.shape: no /PageLabels at all — the negative control

labels-kids-deep.pdf.shape: a /Kids tree whose leaves sit under a second /Kids level

labels-kids-mixed.pdf.shape: /Kids + /Limits number tree, one style per section

labels-kids-prefix.pdf.shape: a /Kids tree carrying /P prefixes and /St offsets

labels-native-mupdf.pdf.shape: the label ranges MuPDF's own set_page_labels writes (flat /Nums, inline dicts) — control

labels-nums-d.pdf.shape: flat /Nums, /S /D with /St 1 — a genuinely arabic file

labels-nums-empty-dict.pdf.shape: a flat /Nums whose range dictionary is empty — no /S, no /P, no /St

labels-nums-inline-dicts.pdf.shape: flat /Nums whose range dictionaries are inline, not referenced

labels-nums-mixed.pdf.shape: flat /Nums, a mixed sequence across three sections (/r, /D, /A + /P)

labels-nums-prefix-only.pdf.shape: a range with /P and no /S — a prefix-only label

labels-nums-prefix.pdf.shape: flat /Nums with /P prefixes on a decimal and a roman range

labels-nums-unknown-style.pdf.shape: a range whose /S is a style this format does not define (/G)

outlines-absent.pdf.shape: no /Outlines at all — empty, not null-everywhere

outlines-action-string.pdf.shape: item /A /GoTo whose /D is a STRING into the /Names → /Dests tree

outlines-dest-and-action.pdf.shape: an item carrying /Dest **and** /A on the same entry (which one a reader honours)

outlines-names-dests-dict.pdf.shape: /Names → /Dests whose value is a destination DICTIONARY behind a reference (what pypdf's add_named_destination writes)

outlines-native-pypdf.pdf.shape: pypdf's own outline: /A /GoTo with an inline /D array, nested through /First

outlines-redactable.pdf.shape: the referenced-/Dests failure, titles matching the page's own words, with a /Info dictionary

outlines-targetless.pdf.shape: items with no destination at all: a heading, a /URI action, and an /SE-only item
